title: Examination Readiness Pack
description: One pack, two selectable regime modules, five stages of regulatory exam management over an institution's own supplied request list. Stage 1 validates intake with a DECLARED as_of date: no runtime clock, so the same inputs always grade the same regardless of when the run happens. Stage 2 rolls up delivered/open/overdue counts and overdue ids. Stage 3 scores readiness as the one-decimal delivered share and grades overall READY (all delivered, zero overdue), NOT_READY (nothing delivered), or AT_RISK (between). Stage 4 (optional input) grades a module-specific checklist: sec-2026 items are AI-use supervision, channel-neutral records preservation, and controls-operate evidence (SEC Division of Examinations FY2026 priorities secs I.B and VII.B; 2022 Rule 17a-4 electronic-recordkeeping amendments, 87 FR 66412); amla items track the EU AML Authority's direct-supervision selection (Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 Arts 12-13, recital 86; first selection concludes by 2028-01-01, direct supervision commences six months after list publication, pre-effective marker before that). Stage 5 (optional input) emits only a pointer set to the existing binder chain (T574 casefile-binder-composer, T575 casefile-binder-verifier, T576 evidence-handover-bundle): composition, never a rebuilt binder. Request lists are synthetic identifiers; not legal advice.

as_of.description: Declared assessment date (YYYY-MM-DD). Never a runtime clock.

module.description: The pack's regime module selector; one pack, module as input.

id.description: Synthetic request identifier, unique within the list.

evidence_request_ids.description: Optional; arms stage 5 (binder-chain pointer set). Ids must match requests[].id.

output_schema.description: Refusal shape: { valid: false, errors: string[] }. Valid shape below; module_annex and evidence_handoff keys appear only when their inputs were supplied.

readiness_pct.description: delivered/total as a one-decimal percentage (IEEE-754 binary64, no intermediate rounding).

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_exam_readiness_pack
mcp_tool_definition.description: Five-stage regulatory exam readiness over a declared request list: intake with declared as_of (no runtime clock), delivered/open/overdue roll-up, readiness score (READY/AT_RISK/NOT_READY), sec-2026 or amla regime-module annex checklist, and a compose-only T574-T576 binder evidence pointer set. Use when an agent needs a deterministic readiness roll-up and regime-module checklist verdict over a supplied exam request list, not legal advice or a prediction of examiner conduct.

module_checklist.description: Optional module checklist assessments {item, status, note?}.

evidence_request_ids.description: Optional request ids to hand off to the binder chain.
